entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
This is completely unacceptable! I need to return this VeloBand Pulse right now and your automated system is giving me the runaround. I want this handled immediately!
I can certainly look into that for you, and I'm sorry for the frustration. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It doesn't matter! I don't want it! My husband is on deployment, and I've been alone dealing with our son's emergency trip to the hospital. He needed major surgery! I haven't had a second to think about this piece of junk.
Oh my goodness, I am so sorry to hear that. That sounds incredibly stressful, and I hope your son is recovering well. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility for you right away.

You'd better. I'm a VIP member and I spend thousands here. If this isn't sorted out in the next two minutes, I'm canceling my membership and you can read all about it in my reviews. Get me your manager!

I completely understand your frustration, sir, and there's no need for a manager. I can absolutely resolve this for you. I'm looking at our return policy right now, and I see that you are well within the 90-day return window for your VeloBand Pulse.
Ninety days? The email I got said something completely different. Are you absolutely sure about that?

Yes, absolutely certain. My system confirms all our products have a 90-day return policy. You received the item just 19 days ago, so there is no issue at all. I sincerely apologize for any confusing communication you might have received. I am processing a full refund for you now.
A full refund... okay. So what happens now?

You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the next 5 minutes. And sir, as you're one of our valued VIP members, and for all the trouble you've been through with your son's surgery and this confusion, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase. We truly value your business.
Well... okay then. A full refund and a $50 credit. That's more like it. That's the service I expect. Thank you, Sarah.
You are very welcome. Again, I hope your son has a speedy recovery from his emergency. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
